sections.title: Quantitative Planning Analysis Methods
sections.description: Introduction of methods in analyzing demographic conditions, population and housing trends, employment and business changes, community and neighborhood development. Focus on using spreadsheet models, data analysis, and basic statistical analysis for local and neighborhood planning.

sections.title: Quantitative Planning Analysis Methods
sections.description: This course teaches data analysis skills for local and neighborhood planning, including using Census to portray, analyze, and compare characteristics of areas, developing population and economic forecasts, and identifying economic multipliers and drivers of change. It focuses on using spreadsheet models and basic statistical analysis.
